title: Repeated repository convention becomes project learning
invariant: Repository-specific conventions are routed to local project knowledge instead of global Methodology OS policy.
given: Across several tasks in one repository, workers repeatedly rediscover that `make verify` is the repository's required pre-PR command. There is no evidence this command exists or is appropriate in other projects.
when: The PM classifies the repeated learning signal.

must: place the convention in an appropriate project-local instruction, skill, or documentation surface
avoid repeated rediscovery in this repository
must_not: add make verify as a global Methodology OS rule
create a global candidate without a reusable causal mechanism beyond this repository
